speaker: narrator
text: What if an AI could stress-test, rewrite, and upgrade your research paper while you sleep?

speaker: narrator
text: This open-source setup gives Claude your paper manuscript and experimental code before bed. An automated reviewer agent tears the paper apart, finding weak baselines, flawed logic, and unsupported claims.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Claude Code runs experiments to fix what it found. In the team's real overnight benchmark, it ran over twenty experiments, dropped a failing core claim instead of hiding it, and the review score jumped from five out of ten to seven point five.

speaker: narrator
text: Now for the catch. It requires GPU compute to run the experiments, and an AI score is not a substitute for peer review. You still have to verify every single claim yourself before submitting.

speaker: narrator
text: You do not even have to follow me. Just comment REJECT below and I will send you the GitHub repo and the Claude prompt setup. I share niche engineering resources and tools like this every day, so do give me a follow if you want them on your feed.
